podcast.title: Influence on Dave Grohl's Signature Guitar
podcast.body: A model of the ES-335 used by Trini Lopez in the 1960s served as the specific inspiration for Dave Grohl's Gibson DG-355 signature guitar. This highlights how historical instrument usage can inspire contemporary designs. "Dave's guitar is based on a model used by Trini Lopez used back in the 1960s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

awards.title: Grammy Award for Best New Artist (1964)

xref.title: Favorite Guitar and Influence on Signature Model
xref.body: Dave Grohl, known for using many guitars, regards the Gibson Trini Lopez ES-335 as his absolute favorite. This specific model served as the inspiration for his own signature guitar. "But his absolute favorite seems to be a Gibson Trinilope's ES335. He has his own signature model now, but that's the guitar that inspired it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Story of the Electric Guitar - Part 1

xref.title: Signature Gibson DG-355
xref.body: Dave Grohl's affection for his ES-355 guitar led him to collaborate with Gibson in 2005 to design his own signature model, the DG-355. This guitar is notably based on a model that Trini Lopez utilized during the 1960s. "Dave Grohl loves his ES-355 so much that he got together with Gibson in 2005 to design a signature guitar, and it's called, of course, the DG-355."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
